detaileddescription.para: This is the probability for a branch being taken to a block that terminates (eventually) in unreachable. These are predicted as unlikely as possible. All reachable probability will proportionally share the remaining part.

strcmp and similar functions return zero, negative, or positive, if the first string is equal, less, or greater than the second.

detaileddescription.para: We consider it likely that the strings are not equal, so a comparison with zero is probably false, but also a comparison with any other number is also probably false given that what exactly is returned for nonzero values is not specified. Any kind of comparison other than equality we know nothing about.

briefdescription.para: This is the probability for an ordered floating point comparison.
